To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We developed a genetic transformation system using particle bombardment for tropical maize inbred lines via transformation of immature zygomatic embryos.

the use of a higher osmolarity during the pre-bombardment embryo cultivation and the use of a helium gas pressure of approximately 1,100 psig during bombardment are important factors to increase the genetic transformation efficiency of maize inbred lines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a genetic transformation system of maize tropical inbred genotypes by particle bombardment of the immature zygotic embryo.
the development of a protocol for the transformation of Brazilian maize tropical lines by particle bombardment of zygotic embryos.

the development of a genetic transformation system to produce transgenic maize plants expressing desirable agronomic traits, which can be used in the development of new cultivars adapted to the tropical conditions of Brazil.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

particle bombardment is a reliable method for the transformation of maize inbred lines and that the protocol developed in this study can be used to produce transgenic maize plants expressing desirable agronomic traits.

this study has provided a new protocol for the production of transgenic maize lines via particle bombardment and has demonstrated the potential of this technique to improve the efficiency of genetic transformation of tropical maize inbred lines.
the results obtained in this work will be very useful in future research on genetic transformation of maize tropical inbred L3 and L 1345.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a protocol for genetic transformation of maize inbred lines by biolistic bombardment of immature embryos.
the best conditions to transform the maize tropical inbred line L3 was to bombard immature embryos at 4h of culture in 0.3 M mannitol, 1.1 kpsi, two shots per dish and 6.6cm.

the use of the best particle bombardment parameters and the use of the CaMV 35S promoter to drive the expression of the bar and uidA transgenes resulted in the development of a reliable genetic transformation system to produce transgenic maize lines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the transformation of maize genotypes from different germplasm is possible by particle bombardment.
the use of the particle bombardment technique for the genetic transformation maize inbred lines L1345 and L3 is feasible and efficient.
the optimization of the genetic transformation system of tropical maize inbred lines is possible by using the immature zygotic embryo and the particle bombardment technique.
